name: Linear Regression
description: Least-squares regression of one numeric response on one or more numeric predictors, optionally per group. coefficients mode returns one row per term (intercept and each predictor) with std_error, t_statistic, p_value, ci_low, ci_high and vif plus the model fit (r2, adj_r2, f_statistic, f_p_value, rmse, df_residual); diagnostics mode returns one row per fit with the model-level statistics including Durbin-Watson, AIC and BIC; predict mode keeps every input row and adds the prediction, residual, prediction interval, sampled_rows and total_rows (so a fit on a sample is visible). Standard errors are classical or HC1 heteroskedasticity-consistent. Categorical predictors are not supported (encode them first); n must exceed the number of parameters.

x.title: Predictors
x.description: One or more numeric predictor columns; every predictor is a term of the model.

group_by.title: Group by
group_by.description: Optional grouping columns: one fit per group.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: coefficients returns one row per term; diagnostics returns one row per fit; predict returns the input rows plus prediction, residual and prediction interval.

intercept.title: Fit intercept
intercept.description: When false the model has no intercept term.

robust.title: Standard errors
robust.description: none uses the classical residual-variance covariance; hc1 uses the heteroskedasticity-consistent sandwich estimator with the n/(n-p) correction.

alpha.title: Significance level
alpha.description: Confidence level of the coefficient and prediction intervals: 1 - alpha. Must be in (0, 1).

sample_rows.title: Sample rows
sample_rows.description: 0 keeps the 100k-row cap and fails above it; a positive N fits on a deterministic reservoir sample of N rows (DuckDB USING SAMPLE reservoir(N ROWS) REPEATABLE(seed)), reproducible without sorting the input. predict mode reports sampled_rows and total_rows.

seed.title: Sampling seed
seed.description: Seed for the repeatable reservoir sample; the same input and seed give the same fit. Ignored when sample_rows is 0. Must be 0 or positive.

output.title: Prediction column
output.description: Name of the prediction column added by predict mode.
